data.name: F1® 25
data.detailed_description:
F1® 25: 2026 Season Edition


Buy the 2026 Season Edition to receive:
  • F1® 25
  • F1® 25: 2026 Season Pack

Rewrite The Grid with the ultimate evolution in racing: EA SPORTS™ F1® 25: 2026 Season Edition. Get F1® 25 and the 2026 Season Pack in one bundle for the most complete Formula One® experience. Race through the action-packed 2025 season, then step into a new era with the ground breaking 2026 cars, the next generation of Grand Prix™ racing.


F1® 25: 2026 Season Pack, Available Now!


Rewrite the grid with the 2026 Season Pack for EA SPORTS™ F1® 25, the official video game of the 2026 FIA Formula One World Championship™. Audi, following its takeover of Sauber, and Cadillac, the first major American manufacturer in Formula One, join the grid to begin a new chapter in F1's history. Driver line-ups have shifted across the field, with rookie Arvid Lindblad racing alongside Liam Lawson at Racing Bulls, Isack Hadjar joining Oracle Red Bull Racing to partner Max Verstappen, and fan favourites Valtteri Bottas and Sergio Pérez leading Cadillac's debut entry.

For the first time since 2023, a new circuit joins the calendar: MADRING. Set in Madrid, this hybrid street and purpose-built track delivers high-speed action across 5.4 km and 22 adrenaline-filled corners. To master it, step into the cockpit of next-generation cars shaped by the biggest regulatory overhaul in F1 history. These new machines are lighter and more responsive, whether you're using a gamepad or a wheel. With cutting-edge active aerodynamics and the introduction of Overtake Mode, you'll have greater control as you go wheel-to-wheel in the new era of Formula One.


About the Game

Rewrite The Grid with the ultimate evolution in racing: EA SPORTS™ F1® 25: 2026 Season Edition. Get F1® 25 and the 2026 Season Pack in one bundle for the most complete Formula One® experience. Race through the action-packed 2025 season, then step into a new era with the groundbreaking 2026 cars, the next generation of Grand Prix™ racing.

  • All New Teams: Two new teams join the 2026 grid; Audi, taking over Sauber, and Cadillac, marking the arrival of the first major American car manufacturer in Formula 1.

  • New Driver Lineups: Race against the latest driver lineups. Racing Bulls welcomes Arvid Lindblad alongside Liam Lawson, Isack Hadjar joins Max Verstappen at Oracle Red Bull Racing, and fan favorites Valtteri Bottas and Sergio Pérez headline Cadillac’s entry.

  • New Track: Get ready to race at MADRING†, the first new F1® circuit since 2023. Set in Madrid, this hybrid street and purpose-built track will challenge you in high-speed action across 5.4 km and 22 adrenaline-filled corners.

  • New Cars and Regulations††: Feel the thrill of the 2026 F1® grid and get behind the wheel of lighter, smaller cars with cutting-edge active aerodynamics for a more responsive drive, whether you're using a gamepad or a wheel. These next-gen cars, enhanced by F1® 25's improved physics, offer exhilarating racing for both seasoned pros and newcomers ready to conquer the new F1® era.

Leave your mark on the world of racing in F1® 25, the official video game of the 2025 FIA Formula One World Championship™

  • Konnersport's Legacy: For the first time ever, extend your Konnersport experience in Career & My Team Modes

  • Design your own Team: Enhance both My Team and F1® World cars and create liveries that are more reflective of Formula One® as you customize driver numbers and move, scale, or rotate logos

  • Accurate LIDAR Circuits: Experience 5 rebuilt tracks, including fan-favorite Suzuka with laser-scanned models of the real venues

  • New Online Co-op Events: Brand new multiplayer mode in F1® World, where you and your friends race as a squad against AI drivers

  • And more: New cinematics, updated podium scenes, and Reverse Tracks on select circuits

This game includes optional in-game purchases of virtual currency that can be used to acquire virtual in-game items.

Custom teams and career saves from the 2025 season do not transfer to 2026 season. Konnersport or APXGP teams cannot be added to the 2026 season of Driver Career or My Team.

†MADRING circuit can only be driven with 2026 cars.
††Some final car models will release in a post-launch update; internet connection required.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit Version 21H1 or newer
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6400 | Core i5-9600k (VR) or AMD Ryzen 3 1200 | Ryzen 5 2600X (VR)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 (6GB) | GTX 1660Ti (VR) | RTX 2060 (RT) // AMD RX 570 (8GB) | RX 590 (VR) | 6700XT (RT) // Intel Arc A380 (VR/RT)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 100 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible
  • VR Support: Meta Quest 3 + Link // Meta Quest 2 + Link // Oculus Rift S // HTC Cosmos // HTC Vive Pro // Valve Index // HP Reverb G2
  • Additional Notes: CPU: AVX2, 4 cores @ 2.2Ghz or greater // GPU: Shader Model 6.6 or newer // Network: 1Mbps up with < 60ms ping

data.legal_notice:
Internet connection & all game updates required to access the final F1® teams’ 2025 cars, certain circuits, content (as applicable) and F2™ 2025 & 2026 season updates. Internet connection; Steam Account; acceptance of EA User Agreement (terms.ea.com) required to play. EA’s Privacy & Cookie Policy applies to your use of EA's services. You consent to any personal data collected through your use of EA's services being transferred to the United States, as further explained in the Privacy & Cookie Policy. EA Account required for online features including Unranked Multiplayer mode & 2026 Season Edition content. You must link your EA and Steam Accounts to access online features; EA may share your Account ID &/or individual game and play records with Steam to validate your purchase &/or refund request. Access to software content is limited to one EA &/or one Steam Account & is non-transferable after purchase. You may need to be 13+ or 16+ to register for an EA Account (age may vary, see o.ea.com/ea/child-access for details). Some content may require gameplay to unlock. Content updates may be downloaded automatically, require additional storage, and incur bandwidth usage fees. EA may provide certain free incremental content &/or updates. EA may retire online features after 30 days notice posted on ea.com/service-updates.
